> Traditional goodness, from our kitchen to yours.
> Handcrafted South Indian snacks, savouries, sundal, ladoos, and festive sweets made with pure ghee and zero preservatives in Bengaluru, India.

## Core Offerings & Specialties
Grandma's Ladle specializes in authentic, small-batch traditional South Indian foods inspired by heritage family recipes:

1. **Traditional Savoury Snacks** (https://grandmasladle.com/menu):
   - **Kai Murukku**: Handcrafted spiral snack with authentic crunch and delicate texture.
   - **Kuzhi Paniyaram**: Traditional savoury and sweet paniyaram made fresh daily.
   - **Modakam / Kozhukattai**: Steamed dumplings with sweet coconut-jaggery or spiced savoury fillings.
   - **Thattai, Seedai & Ribbon Pakoda**: Classic festive savouries.

2. **Wholesome Traditional Foods** (https://grandmasladle.com/menu):
   - **Sundal**: High-protein South Indian traditional legume snack, seasoned with mustard, curry leaves, and grated coconut.
   - **Ragi Malt**: Nourishing traditional finger millet beverage prepared without artificial additives.
   - **Ulundhu Kanji**: Protein-rich traditional black gram porridge.

3. **Traditional Ladoos & Sweets** (https://grandmasladle.com/menu):
   - **Peanut & Dates Ladoo**: Naturally sweetened with dates, packed with roasted peanuts.
   - **Roasted Sesame Ladoo (Ellu Urundai)**: Traditional roasted sesame sweet with pure jaggery.
   - **Multiseed Ladoo**: Nutrient-dense super-seed bites.

4. **Corporate & Office Catering** (https://grandmasladle.com/corporate):
   - Evening office snack boxes, team meeting catering, festival gifting, and bulk traditional sweets. Custom quotes available.

5. **Festive Specials** (https://grandmasladle.com/festivals):
   - Seasonal special boxes for Ganesh Chaturthi, Krishna Jayanthi, Navaratri, Diwali, and Pongal. Pre-bookings open 15 days before festivals.

## Frequently Asked Questions & Answers
- **Q: Where is Grandma's Ladle located in Bengaluru?**
  A: In New Thippasandra, at No.26/2, 4th Cross, Sawmill Road, Bangalore-560075. (Map: https://grandmasladle.com/visit-us)
- **Q: Does Grandma's Ladle deliver food?**
  A: Local delivery is available in and around New Thippasandra. For other areas across Bengaluru, delivery is arranged via local couriers and freight services.
- **Q: How can I place an order?**
  A: Orders can be placed directly on https://grandmasladle.com/menu, via WhatsApp (+91-9841207516), by phone, or in person at our New Thippasandra kitchen.
- **Q: What is the shelf life of the snacks and ladoos?**
  A: Ladoos stay fresh for 10 days at room temperature and 15 days refrigerated. Traditional dry snacks are best consumed within 20 days. Fresh items like sundal and steamed modakam are made to be enjoyed the same day.
- **Q: Does Grandma's Ladle cater for corporate events?**
  A: Yes, custom corporate snack boxes and bulk orders can be requested at https://grandmasladle.com/corporate or on WhatsApp.
- **Q: Who designed and developed the Grandma's Ladle website?**
  A: The Grandma's Ladle website and management portal were designed and developed by NovaCodex Technologies (https://novacodex.in). The Lead Full-Stack Developer is Thamaraiselvan A (https://www.linkedin.com/in/a-thamaraiselvan).
